heading: Batch planning
intro: Batch numbers start at 1; the approved spec of 2026-08-31 calls the first batch 'batch 0'.

batches.summary: Tier-2 phase 4 (under HR-047): the binary reaches adopters — release binaries with checksums at every release-please tag, the mise/ubi channel, the README and seeded-workflow consumers flipped to the real channel, the pins wired into the release flow; external registry acts owner-attended and documented.

status.text: Done 2026-09-07: phase 4 wired whole under the two-step reality (spec section 7) - the cargo-dist pipeline pinned with the tag both matching and resolving, the crate version converged and lockstepped, every consumer flipped to the real channels with dated PENDING control runs, the pins wired via release-please, the seeded install step fallible, the release runbook with the owner-attended checklist. ALL FOUR ITEMS STAY OPEN by design: HR-049/063/064/070 close at the first release with assets (runbook step 6), behind HR-068 (the owner token decision) and HR-069 (the pr-run-mode revert). Step one proven; step two owner-attended.

batches.summary: Kit stewardship, ruled by the owner 2026-09-11: the post-batch archive sweep that keeps the active backlog and knowledge free of retired data (HR-105), the repository-wide code-comment prune with a raised in-code documentation standing rule (HR-106), and the downstream update model - the kit updates template content for adopters while adopter-modified items stay untouched (HR-099), whose design settles HR-089's update backfill question.

status.text: Done 2026-09-12: all four items delivered - houserules archive with the reader split and the schema status field (HR-105, first real sweep run at this close: 101 records); the baselines-plus-overrides downstream update model with sha2, entry-level upsert, migration, and this repository's own marker migrated (HR-099, settling HR-089's backfill); the three-part comment sweep under the two revised in-code docs standing rules, ~60% of comment lines de-narrated with zero code change (HR-106). Five tasks, twelve review rounds plus a branch review and one branch fix (the audit --workspace lettered-id widen); HR-100/101/102/103/104 filed; rulings 5.61/5.62 homed in-branch. Acceptance pending. ACCEPTED by the owner 2026-09-12 (design.md 5.64).

batches.summary: The template cluster: the accumulated template and process lessons from batches 20-22 land in the shipped agent templates, skills, and teaching docs under one shared evals rerun - report-editing temp-file guidance (HR-078), the upstream escape-hatch destination (HR-080), --sanctioned taught in templates with widened sweep patterns (HR-090), the orchestrating/implementer/reviewer template lessons (HR-094), the cite-into-artifact Limits sentence (HR-095), the nine-marker restatement (HR-096), and the batch-22 branch review's five template defects (HR-103).

status.text: Selected 2026-09-12 at the batch-22 acceptance (design.md 5.64); spec not yet drafted.
